climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A large Victorian zone containing Bendigo, Goulburn Valley, Heathcote, Strathbogie Ranges and Upper Goulburn. Shiraz dominates at 67 percent of plantings, with Chardonnay at 9 and Cabernet Sauvignon at 8.
